description: Source code for proxy configuration service on macOS, handling system proxy settings, including auto-detect, PAC files, proxies for various schemes, and bypass rules, with observer pattern implementation.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceMac
classes.description: Manages system proxy configuration on macOS, observes network changes, and notifies observers.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceMac::Helper
classes.description: Reference-counted helper class for posting proxy config change notifications between threads.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceMac::Forwarder
classes.description: Facilitates setting notification keys and handling network config change callbacks.

methods.name: GetBoolFromDictionary
methods.description: Extracts a boolean value from a CFDictionary with a default fallback.

methods.name: GetCurrentProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current system proxy settings and constructs a ProxyConfigWithAnnotation.
